title: Internal: Applying Credits to Savings Accounts
summary: Explains when and how agents may apply credits to customer savings accounts: only for interest corrections (system error affecting APY boost/tier rate/relationship bonus), fee refunds (incorrectly charged fees), or rare goodwill credits (supervisor approval over $25). Agents must verify identity/ownership, confirm the account is a savings account, calculate the discrepancy/fee amount, then use apply_savings_account_credit_6831(account_id, amount>0, credit_type) and inform the customer of the updated balance; interest corrections also require submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294.
faqs: In what situations are agents allowed to apply credits to a customer’s savings account?
